title: John Harbaugh opens up on ‘tough’ Ravens ending: ‘Hits you hard’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh opens up on ‘tough’ Ravens ending: ‘Hits you hard’
sources.description: Almost immediately after being dismissed by the Ravens, Harbaugh became arguably the most sought-after head coach in the NFL, landing with the Giants on a five-year, $100 million contract.
